notes: Read against the maker's source at commit eb902fa on master. Five commits carry version 2.0.0 (467f615, c7d1e50, 0d5a3ae, 3310de2, eb902fa); the only code change among them is 0d5a3ae, which deleted the MFTexture and BitMap destructors to stop a crash on exit. The installed binary settles it: BitMap::~BitMap at 0x340c and __shared_ptr_emplace<MFTexture>::__on_zero_shared at 0x39e0 neither call MFTexture::release, so the build shipped is 0d5a3ae or later, and the source at eb902fa is identical to it apart from the README. The whole plugin is eleven blank panels built from one template, src/Blanks.cpp, parameterised by width. Each loads a PNG rather than an SVG, so the panels do not render with rsvg-convert; the artwork is in res/8Bit_<n>HP.png, res/8Bit_Alt_<n>HP.png and res/8Bit_Ext_<n>HP.png. The three menu items are confirmed in the binary: "Alternative" and "Extreme" appear as literals, and "Base" is inlined as a short string, 0x6142 with a length of 4 at 0x3e80 inside BlankBaseWidget::appendContextMenu. The picture choice is a field on the widget, not on the module, and nm finds no dataToJson or dataFromJson anywhere in the binary, so the choice cannot be saved with the patch. Under the house rule a cosmetic menu gets no line, but a blank panel is the exception STYLE names: being looked at is the module's whole function, so the three artwork items are written on each of them. No ports and no parameters anywhere in the plugin, so there are no tags, families or props to give.

lines: A blank panel 1HP wide, with no controls and no jacks, for filling a gap in the rack; the artwork is drawn in an 8-bit home-computer style
Menu — Base — draws the first of the three pictures made for this width
Menu — Alternative — draws the second of the three pictures made for this width
Menu — Extreme — draws the third of the three pictures made for this width
Note — the picture is not saved with the patch, so the panel returns to Base whenever the patch is loaded again
Blank1HP.notes: src/Blanks.cpp:70-73 builds the three filenames from res/8Bit_%dHP.png, res/8Bit_Alt_%dHP.png and res/8Bit_Ext_%dHP.png with the width substituted; :46-60 adds the three menu items. The module class is rack::Module itself, with no process and no JSON, so the panel choice lives only on the widget.
